explanation: Because pristine ef70 omitted base_url on GET, the mounted edit form held a blank string. When Save was clicked unchanged under current19, the frontend sent base_url: null, clearing the database override from http://127.0.0.1:19991/ to null and bumping spec_revision from 2 to 3. This empirically proves the upgrade regression where saving an unedited form loaded under the old backend clears the database override.
